name: Merkzeug
subtitle: Your Markdown. Connected.
description_ios:
Your Markdown. Connected.

Explore and edit Markdown collections — from personal notebooks to documentation written by coding agents. Merkzeug helps you navigate related files, follow links and understand diagrams without moving your notes out of their folders or repositories.

YOUR PERSONAL NOTEBOOK
Keep ideas, projects and meeting notes together as ordinary Markdown files. Write visually with headings, lists, tables and images. Edit titles, tags and other frontmatter to keep the context with every file. No Git repository is required.

YOUR REPOSITORY, YOUR FILES
Clone your repository in Working Copy, then open its folder in Merkzeug through the Files app. Edit notes in Merkzeug; commit, push and pull in Working Copy. Working Copy is a separate app, and access depends on its file-provider support and configuration. Merkzeug does not run Git commands on iOS.

SEE THE CONNECTIONS
Follow links between notes, view Mermaid diagrams inside your documents, and edit titles, tags and other frontmatter. Write visually with headings, lists, tables and images while keeping ordinary Markdown files.

FROM MOBILE NOTES TO DESKTOP PDF
Use the same Markdown files in Merkzeug for Mac to export notes and directly linked documents with reusable PDF templates. PDF export and template management are not available in this iOS app.

Merkzeug combines the German words merken (to remember) and Werkzeug (tool): a tool for thoughts worth keeping. It reads and edits your documents; it does not run a coding agent. The interface and built-in help are available in English and German.

Merkzeug is available for macOS, iPhone and iPad, and as a plugin for IntelliJ IDEA (beta).
description_macos:
Your Markdown. Connected.

YOUR PERSONAL NOTEBOOK
Keep ideas, projects and meeting notes together as ordinary Markdown files. Write visually with headings, lists, tables and images. Edit titles, tags and other frontmatter to keep the context with every file. No Git repository is required.

TRACK CHANGES. WORK TOGETHER.
Version and sync your Markdown files with Git. Open a local Git repository as your notebook. See the branch and changed files, commit and push your edits, and pull updates from Merkzeug. Git must be installed and your repository and authentication configured; resolve complex conflicts in your preferred Git client.

FROM CALENDAR TO MEETING NOTES
Choose an event from your Mac calendars and create a Markdown meeting note with its title, date, time, location and available attendees. Keep meeting context together with your notes. Calendar access requires your permission.

PUBLISH WITH PDF TEMPLATES
Export a note or a set of directly linked notes as a PDF. Reuse a template with a cover, headers, footers, logos, styles and page margins. Assign templates per notebook and use frontmatter for export titles, exclusions and a clickable table of contents.

READ WHAT YOUR AGENTS WRITE
Explore Markdown documentation created by coding agents in your repository. Follow links, view integrated Mermaid diagrams and edit frontmatter without moving your files into another format.
